# ui::Inline

Header: `winui/ui/text/Inlines.hpp`.

One run of inline text with its own formatting. Every formatting field left at its default inherits the containing block's.

An inline with [`on_click`](#on_click) or [`navigate_uri`](#navigate_uri) is a link. It is underlined and drawn in the theme's link colors. A press and release on it calls [`on_click`](#on_click), then opens [`navigate_uri`](#navigate_uri). Inlines go to [TextControl::set_inlines()](../controls/text.md#set_inlines) or [`ui::Text::inlines`](../controls/text.md#uitext-inlines), or into a [Paragraph](paragraph.md) for [RichText](../controls/rich-text.md#uirichtext).

Example: 
```cpp
window.set_content(ui::Text{
    .inlines = {
        {.text = "Text can be "},
        {.text = "bold", .weight = ui::FontWeight::Bold},
        {.text = ", "},
        {.text = "underlined", .underline = true},
        ui::line_break(),
        {.text = "or a link", .on_click = [] { std::println("clicked"); }, .navigate_uri = "https://example.com/"},
    },
});
```

## text

```cpp
std::string text
```

The run's text (UTF-8). `\n` is a line break.

## font_family

```cpp
std::optional<std::string> font_family {}
```

The font family; unset inherits.

```cpp

```

The font size in DIPs; unset inherits.

```cpp
std::optional<FontWeight> weight {}
```

The font weight; unset inherits.

## italic

```cpp
bool italic = false
```

Italic. Only switches italic on; an italic block stays italic.

```cpp
std::optional<Color> color {}
```

The text color; unset inherits.

## on_click

```cpp
std::function<void()> on_click {}
```

Makes the inline a link that calls this when clicked. It is a std::function because inlines are brace-initialized in vectors, which copy them (see spec/Common.hpp's handler note).

## navigate_uri

```cpp
std::string navigate_uri {}
```

Makes the inline a link that opens [`navigate_uri`](#navigate_uri) in its default app when clicked, after [`on_click`](#on_click).

## is_link

```cpp
bool is_link() const
```

Whether this inline is a link, which means it has [`on_click`](#on_click) or a [`navigate_uri`](#navigate_uri).
